card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS warning words
card.fires_on: Partway through a long word written in all capitals, usually in a boxed warning or heading, where the word is split into pieces and more letters must follow.

modes.label: Split medical words in caps
modes.description: A middle piece of a long capitalized medical term in a warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: LEFT VENTRIC<<ULAR>> DYSFUNCTION AND EMBRYO

modes.label: Split drug names in caps
modes.description: A middle piece of a capitalized drug name in an instruction line.
modes.example: DO NOT ADD LEV<<OTH>>YROXINE SODIUM FOR

modes.label: Caps linking words
modes.description: A short word within an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: ALT LEVELS BECOME INCREASED ≥ 2 TIMES<< THE>> UPPER LIMIT OF NORMAL

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words typed in capital letters in warning headings, before the word is finished.
